title: Perspective on tailoring quantum coherence with electron beams
summary: Examining and controlling the interaction between semiconductor quantum qubits and their environment can boost semiconductor quantum technologies, which have many applications in table-top quantum computing hardware. Electron beams in electron microscopes have opened up a new avenue for the quantum-coherent probing of semiconductor excitations and strong-coupling effects.
